AI Artist Video Prompts — Fan Intro Clips

Purpose: Short "hi from the artist" intro videos for each AI artist. ~15–30 seconds. Use reference photos as the source image in Kling AI or Runway Gen-3.

Recommended tool: Kling AI (app.klingai.com) — best for realistic human movement from a photo. Use Image-to-Video mode.

🎸 KADE RIVERS — Fan Intro Video

Source image: file_39---81acd140.jpg (studio composite — best full-body reference)

Kling / Runway prompt:

Male rock musician in his late 20s standing in a recording studio, long dark hair, tribal tattoo sleeves, wearing a black t-shirt. He looks directly into the camera with a slight nod, raises one hand in a casual wave, and speaks: "Hey, I'm Kade Rivers. Welcome." Subtle smile — not grinning, just real. Moody studio lighting, warm amber and teal tones, mixing console and microphone visible in background. Natural head movement. Cinematic, authentic, unpolished.

Platform use: Instagram Reels intro, TikTok profile pin, YouTube channel trailer, EPK

Caption idea:

"Hey. I'm Kade. This is what I do. 🎸"

💃 MADISON BLAIR — Fan Intro Video

Source image: Use her confirmed reference photo (half-body stage shot or best headshot available)

Kling / Runway prompt:

Young woman in her early 20s, polished pop artist aesthetic, confident and glamorous. She stands facing the camera, slight smile growing into a full confident grin, gives a small wave with her fingers, and speaks: "Hi, I'm Madison Blair — and I'm so happy you're here." Hair moves slightly, natural blink, genuine warmth. Background: softly lit, blurred pink and gold bokeh, upscale vibe. Smooth, polished movement. Aspirational and inviting energy.

Platform use: TikTok profile pin, Instagram Reels, Spotify canvas intro

Caption idea:

"Hi, I'm Madison. Let's have some fun. 💫"

🎧 ARIA VALE — Fan Intro Video

Source image: aria-vale.jpg (headshot — confirmed)

Kling / Runway prompt:

Young woman, early-to-mid 20s, authentic and magnetic EDM artist. She looks directly into the camera with natural warmth and energy. "Freedom in frequency. I'm Aria Vale. 🎶"

Generation Tips

  • Kling AI: Go to app.klingai.com → Image to Video → upload reference photo → paste prompt → set duration to 5–10 seconds → generate. Run 2–3 variations and pick the best.
  • Runway Gen-3: Similar — upload image, paste prompt, generate.
  • Settings: Use highest quality mode available. For Kling: "Standard" or "Pro" mode.
  • Lip sync: After generating the video, run through HeyGen or Sync.so to add real lip-sync to the spoken line. This makes it look like they're actually talking.
  • Music bed: Add a 5-second clip of each artist's future track under the video when available.

Next Steps After Videos

  1. Generate intro clips in Kling AI using above prompts
  2. Run through HeyGen/Sync.so for lip sync on the spoken line
  3. Add artist logo overlay at end (use existing logo files)
  4. Upload to TikTok + Instagram Reels as profile-pinned intro posts
  5. Use as Spotify Canvas on first single when released
